name: Meeting API
description: Models meetings as entities and runs them through pluggable backend plugins.
provides_plugin_types: meeting_api_backend (Plugin/MeetingApiBackend, attribute Drupal\meeting_api\Attribute\Backend, interface Drupal\meeting_api\BackendInterface, manager Drupal\meeting_api\BackendPluginManager)
meeting_api_time_constraint (Plugin/MeetingApiTimeConstraint, attribute Drupal\meeting_api_scheduler\Attribute\TimeConstraint; provided by the meeting_api_scheduler submodule)
project_description: A framework module that models meetings as a revisionable content entity and delegates the actual conferencing technology to pluggable backend plugins, so a site can create, list and reference meetings without binding itself to one provider. Ships a Manual URL backend and an optional FullCalendar-based scheduler. Alpha; provides an API only, with no permission logic beyond admin gating.
